import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorModulesTensor
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianNaturality
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFamilyZero

/-!
# Divisor presentations of tensor powers

If the pullback of a line bundle is `O(A)`, the pullback of its `n`-th
tensor power is `O(n A)`. This is the tensor-power step in the large-twist
construction used for the divisor Grassmannian comparison.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

namespace Modules

/-- Tensor powers of a line bundle remain locally trivial. -/
theorem tensorPow_isLocallyTrivial {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {L : X.Modules} (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial (tensorPow L n)
  | 0 => isLocallyTrivial_unit'
  | n + 1 => tensorObj_isLocallyTrivial (tensorPow_isLocallyTrivial hL n) hL

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Pullback commutes with powers of a line bundle. The one-sided local
triviality theorem supplies the tensor comparison at each successor. -/
noncomputable def pullbackTensorPowIsoOfLocallyTrivial {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ X) (L : X.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) :
    (n : ℕ) → (pullback f).obj (tensorPow L n) ≅
      tensorPow ((pullback f).obj L) n
  | 0 => pullbackUnitIso f
  | n + 1 =>
      @asIso _ _ _ _ (pullbackTensorMap f (tensorPow L n) L)
        (pullbackTensorMap_isIso_of_right_locallyTrivial f _ L hL) ≪≫
      tensorObjIsoOfIso (pullbackTensorPowIsoOfLocallyTrivial f L hL n) (Iso.refl _)

end Modules

variable (K : Type u) [Field K] {X : Scheme.{u}}
  [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
  [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]

omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] in
/-- Weighted divisor degree scales with a natural multiple. -/
theorem CurveDivisor.deg_nsmul (A : X.CurveDivisor) (n : ℕ) :
    CurveDivisor.deg K (n • A) = (n : ℤ) * CurveDivisor.deg K A := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n hn =>
      rw [succ_nsmul, CurveDivisor.deg_add, hn, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      ring

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Tensor powers of a divisor module are the modules of the corresponding
multiples of the divisor, using rational multiplication at each successor. -/
noncomputable def divisorModulesTensorPowIso (A : X.CurveDivisor) :
    (n : ℕ) → Modules.tensorPow (divisorModules K A) n ≅ divisorModules K (n • A)
  | 0 => (divisorModulesZeroIso K).symm ≪≫
      eqToIso (by rw [zero_smul])
  | n + 1 =>
      Modules.tensorObjIsoOfIso (divisorModulesTensorPowIso A n) (Iso.refl _) ≪≫
      divisorModulesTensorIso K (n • A) A ≪≫
      eqToIso (by rw [succ_nsmul])

/-- A divisor presentation of a pulled-back line bundle controls every
power of the same original bundle. -/
noncomputable def pullbackTensorPowDivisorIso {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (L : Y.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (A : X.CurveDivisor) (e : (Modules.pullback f).obj L ≅ divisorModules K A)
    (n : ℕ) :
    (Modules.pullback f).obj (Modules.tensorPow L n) ≅ divisorModules K (n • A) :=
  Modules.pullbackTensorPowIsoOfLocallyTrivial f L hL n ≪≫
    Modules.tensorPowCongr e n ≪≫ divisorModulesTensorPowIso K A n

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
